vaporize.name: VAPORIZE
vaporize.effect: Steam burst damage + creates a blinding mist cloud that reduces enemy accuracy.

shatter.name: SHATTER
shatter.effect: Shatters solid ice for ×3 burst damage and sprays razor ice shards.

superconduct.name: SUPERCONDUCT
superconduct.effect: Breaks target shields and amplifies all incoming damage by +30% for 4s.

toxic_blast.name: TOXIC BLAST
toxic_blast.effect: Detonates poison stacks into a wide fiery blast and spreads venom nearby.

paralysis.name: PARALYSIS
paralysis.effect: Neuro-electric shock that stuns the target for 1.0s and interrupts telegraphs.

overload.name: OVERLOAD
overload.effect: Thermo-electric explosion dealing heavy AoE damage and strong knockback.

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.title: Tank / Frontline Protector
vanguard.passiveDesc: Armor regenerates faster (3.0s delay); each enemy projectile blocked by Ruby Shield Wall reloads 1 round (or vents 15% Heat) and grants +15% damage to the next attack (up to +75%).
vanguard.skillDesc: Deploys a 120° energy shield blocking and storing enemy bullets before releasing a shockwave. Allied bullets fired through the shield gain +30% damage and +1 pierce.
vanguard.synergy: Allied and Tesla Turret shots passing through the shield gain +30% damage and +1 target pierce.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.title: Marksman / Target Marker
ranger.passiveDesc: Damage scales with distance to target (up to +30%); +10% base Crit Chance.
ranger.skillDesc: Backflips (i-frames) while firing a piercing arrow that Marks enemies for 6s: +25% damage taken from ALL sources, revealed through fog, and drops a Prey Emblem (-2.0s skill CD, instant Overclocked reload/0% Heat) on death.
ranger.synergy: Marked targets take +25% damage from the whole team, are prioritized by Tesla Turrets, and drop a Prey Emblem (-2.0s skill CD, instant Overclocked reload/0% Heat) on death.

elementalist.name: Elementalist
elementalist.title: Crowd Control / Elemental Weaver
elementalist.passiveDesc: Rotates Fire → Ice → Lightning after each skill cast; primary attacks apply the active element.
elementalist.skillDesc: Launches an orb that expands into a 5s Elemental Zone. Allied bullets flying through the zone are imbued with its element.
elementalist.synergy: Allies triggering Elemental Reactions on your primed target activate Elemental Convergence for 3.0s (+20% move & fire speed, instant full reload/0% Heat for both players).

druid.name: Druid
druid.title: Support / Nature Healer
druid.passiveDesc: Slain enemies have a 15% chance to drop a 1 HP healing seed that seeks the lowest-HP ally; revives allies 2x faster.
druid.skillDesc: Summons a Sacred Tree that heals 1 HP every 2s, roots enemies for 1.5s, blocks bullets, and taunts foes. Casting on a downed ally revives them instantly with 2 HP.
druid.synergy: Instantly revives downed teammates from afar; Poison attacks combine with allied Fire/Lightning for Toxic Blast and Paralysis.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.title: Utility / Turret Specialist
engineer.passiveDesc: Allies within 4 tiles regenerate Armor 30% faster; can repair and activate ancient map machinery.
engineer.skillDesc: Deploys a chain-lightning turret prioritizing Marked targets. Allied bullets hitting the turret overcharge it; at 100% charge it unleashes an EMP blast stunning enemies and clearing bullets.
engineer.synergy: Allies shooting the Tesla Turret boost its fire rate and trigger a screen-clearing EMP blast at 100% charge.

knight_sword.name: Knight Sword
knight_sword.desc: Wide melee cleave that destroys standard enemy projectiles.

hunter_crossbow.name: Hunter Crossbow
hunter_crossbow.desc: High-velocity piercing bolts with elevated critical chance.

apprentice_staff.name: Apprentice Staff
apprentice_staff.desc: Fires arcane bolts infused with your current element.

thorn_staff.name: Thorn Staff
thorn_staff.desc: Launches briar thorns that inflict stacking Poison damage.

rivet_gun.name: Rivet Gun
rivet_gun.desc: Reliable sidearm firing heated steel rivets with steady accuracy.

scrap_shotgun.name: Scrap Shotgun
scrap_shotgun.desc: Blasts a 5-pellet close-quarters spread with heavy knockback.

gale_smg.name: Gale SMG
gale_smg.desc: Rapid-fire submachine gun ideal for suppressing swarms.

tesla_carbine.name: Tesla Carbine
tesla_carbine.desc: Piercing electro-rifle that arcs chain lightning between foes.

emerald_cleaver.name: Emerald Great-Cleaver
emerald_cleaver.desc: Massive jade blade that cleaves bullets and applies Poison.

solar_archon_staff.name: Solar Archon Staff
solar_archon_staff.desc: Fires 3 bouncing solar fireballs that ricochet across walls.

frag_launcher.name: Frag Grenade Launcher
frag_launcher.desc: Bouncing explosive shells that detonate in fiery blasts.

seed_gun.name: Life-Seed Blaster
seed_gun.desc: Co-op Special: Sprouts a Life Blossom that heals nearby allies.

tether_staff.name: Soul-Tether Staff
tether_staff.desc: Co-op Special: Links an electric tether to an ally, searing foes between you.

focus_laser.name: Focus Beam Rifle
focus_laser.desc: Hyper-velocity thermal beam that pierces 2 targets.

void_staff.name: Void Vortex Staff
void_staff.desc: Pierces 3 targets with corrosive void energy.

berserker_axe.name: Berserker Great-Axe
berserker_axe.desc: Sweeping 155° flame cleave that obliterates enemy bullets.

magma_cannon.name: Molten Magma Cannon
magma_cannon.desc: Heavy siege cannon launching devastating magma payloads.

thunder_hammer.name: Mjolnir Thunder Hammer
thunder_hammer.desc: Smashes projectiles and unleashes 3 lightning shock bolts.

table_tech_rocket.name: Rocket Barricade
table_tech_rocket.desc: Flipping Cover [E] or Wall-Slamming fires 2 Homing Rockets (26 Fire DMG each). Dash-Kicking a barricade launches a 620 px/s Rocket Payload exploding for 60 Fire DMG (r=104px).

table_tech_blank_nova.name: Frost Blank Nova
table_tech_blank_nova.desc: Flipping Cover [E] or triggering a Wall-Slam expands the bullet-clearing pulse to r=160px and Freezes all enemies in range for 1.5s.

table_tech_prism_split.name: Prism Barricade
table_tech_prism_split.desc: Barricades you flip radiate a prism aura: primary bullets fired through split into 2 Shock rays (±12°, +20% Additive DMG). Wall-Slams fire 2 Shock prism rays.

table_tech_billiard_master.name: Battlefield Billiard Master
table_tech_billiard_master.desc: Barricades, barrels, and ice blocks you kick gain +35% speed, ricochet off walls up to 3 times, and deal +40% Wall-Slam damage (+1 extra Boss Stagger).

dash_tidal_ram.name: Tidal Wall-Ram Dash
dash_tidal_ram.desc: Dashing shrouds you in a Frost wave that rams foes (20 Ice DMG, KB=280). Triggering a Wall-Slam refunds 60% Dash cooldown (1.2s ICD).

dash_venom_wake.name: Venom Mercury Wake
dash_venom_wake.desc: Dashing leaves a 3.5s Venom Wake. Dashing through an enemy or Dash-Kicking a prop immediately reloads 50% clip ammo or vents 40% Heat.

dash_flame_shackle.name: Flame Wall-Shackle
dash_flame_shackle.desc: Dashing near an enemy (within 88px) lashes a flame chain that yanks it into the nearest wall or barricade (24 Fire DMG + instant Wall-Slam).

dash_reload_acrobat.name: Acrobatic Reload Dash
dash_reload_acrobat.desc: Dashing while reloading or at >= 50% Heat advances reload by 40% / cools 35% Heat and widens the next [R] Perfect Reload window to 35%–80%.

reload_tediore_chuck.name: Volatile Magazine Chuck
reload_tediore_chuck.desc: On Perfect Reload, Tactical Vent [R], or 3rd Melee hit/parry, hurls a volatile magazine toward the cursor exploding for (18 + 4 × rounds spent) Fire DMG.

reload_frost_nova.name: Reload Frost Nova
reload_frost_nova.desc: On Perfect Reload, Tactical Vent [R], or 3rd Melee hit/parry, pulses a Frost Nova (r=110px, 22 Ice DMG) applying 2 Chill stacks and clearing nearby bullets.

reload_magnet_vortex.name: Magnetic Reload Vortex
reload_magnet_vortex.desc: On Perfect Reload, Tactical Vent [R], or 3rd Melee hit/parry, fires a magnetic anchor 140px ahead that pulls surrounding enemies together for 0.8s.

reload_repulsor_shock.name: Repulsor Shockwave
reload_repulsor_shock.desc: On Perfect Reload, Tactical Vent [R], or 3rd Melee hit/parry, unleashes a 140° repulsor cone (r=165px) blasting status-afflicted foes into walls (KB=260).

bullet_split_bounce.name: Split-Bounce Rounds
bullet_split_bounce.desc: Projectiles gain +1 wall bounce. On their first wall or barricade bounce, primary projectiles split into 2 child rounds (70% DMG each) in a V-pattern.

bullet_ricochet_boom.name: Seismic Ricochet Rounds
bullet_ricochet_boom.desc: Whenever a projectile bounces off a wall or barricade, it triggers a Seismic Fire Blast (24 DMG × procCoeff, r=64px, KB=200) knocking nearby foes away.

bullet_heavy_pinball.name: Heavy Pinball Rounds
bullet_heavy_pinball.desc: Attacks gain +50% Knockback. Enemies Wall-Slammed ricochet backward like pinballs, stunning both enemies for 0.8s if they collide with another foe.

bullet_coop_arc_relay.name: Co-op Arc Relay
bullet_coop_arc_relay.desc: When your shots or swings pass within 56px of an Ally, Summon, or Flipped Barricade, that entity zaps the nearest enemy with a Lightning Arc (20 DMG × procCoeff).

vanguard_bastion_prism.name: Upgrade: Bastion Prism
vanguard_bastion_prism.desc: Widens Ruby Shield Wall: enemy bullets hitting the shield reflect as Fire bolts (20 DMG), and primary allied bullets fired through split into 2 rays.

vanguard_charge.name: Upgrade: Shield Charge
vanguard_charge.desc: Reactivating Ruby Shield Wall charges 130px forward, ramming enemies into walls (triggering Wall-Slam) and releasing a heavy shockwave.

ranger_arrow_volley.name: Upgrade: Arrow Volley
ranger_arrow_volley.desc: Predator Arrow fires a 5-arrow piercing fan; arrows striking walls detonate in a micro-blast that Marks all nearby enemies.

ranger_prey_chain.name: Upgrade: Prey Chain
ranger_prey_chain.desc: Marked targets within 220px are linked by crimson chains, sharing 35% of damage taken and pulling linked foes along when knocked back.

elementalist_vortex.name: Upgrade: Elemental Vortex
elementalist_vortex.desc: Elemental Orb zone generates a gravitational vortex pulling enemies and rolling props within 150px toward its center.

elementalist_twin_orbit.name: Upgrade: Twin Orbit
elementalist_twin_orbit.desc: Deploys twin Elemental Zones (current and next element) linked by a Reaction Cutting Beam (24 DMG/s) that triggers reactions immediately.

druid_poison_roots.name: Upgrade: Poison Roots
druid_poison_roots.desc: Every 1.8s, Sacred Tree lashes briar roots that yank enemies in range into the nearest wall (Wall-Slam) while applying Poison.

druid_sacred_grove.name: Upgrade: Sacred Grove
druid_sacred_grove.desc: Plants 2 Sacred Trees simultaneously; allied bullets fired through a Sacred Tree canopy gain +1 Smart Bounce.

engineer_twin_turrets.name: Upgrade: Twin Turrets
engineer_twin_turrets.desc: Allows 2 Tesla Turrets active at once, automatically linking them with a Lightning Laser Fence that slows enemies by 50%.

engineer_self_destruct.name: Upgrade: Overload Self-Destruct
engineer_self_destruct.desc: Reactivating Skill or turret expiry turns Tesla Turret into a kamikaze bot that charges the densest enemy cluster and explodes for 45 Fire+Shock DMG (r=130px).

table_tech_toxic_shrapnel.name: Toxic Shrapnel Barricade
table_tech_toxic_shrapnel.desc: When a barricade or tactical prop breaks, or on Wall-Slam, fire 8 Toxic Spines in 360° (20 Poison DMG each) and leave a poison puddle.

table_tech_magnet_snare.name: Magnet Snare Barricade
table_tech_magnet_snare.desc: On Flip Cover [E] or Wall-Slam, emit a magnetic pulse pulling up to 4 nearest enemies within 180px in front of the barricade and Stunning them for 0.8s.

dash_thunder_decoy.name: Thunder Decoy Dash
dash_thunder_decoy.desc: Leave a Thunder Decoy (1.5s) at Dash start taunting enemies within 220px; on expiry or enemy bullet touch, explodes for 36 Shock DMG (r=88px) and clears enemy bullets.

dash_phase_blade.name: Phase Blade Dash
dash_phase_blade.desc: After each Dash, your first attack or shot within 1.2s launches a piercing Phase Shockwave Blade (28 DMG) that clears enemy bullets ahead.

reload_caustic_pod.name: Caustic Rolling Pod
reload_caustic_pod.desc: On Perfect Reload / Vent [R] or Finale Shot, launch a Caustic Spore Pod rolling 120px; shooting or Dash-Kicking it detonates acid rain (38 Poison DMG, +25% enemy vulnerability).

reload_holster_surge.name: Holster Surge
reload_holster_surge.desc: Swapping weapons with [Q] (2.0s ICD) fires a piercing lightning bolt (26 Shock DMG) ahead and instantly reloads/cools your holstered weapon.

bullet_wall_tether.name: Wall-Tether Pylons
bullet_wall_tether.desc: When a Finale Shot or Overclocked Shot hits a wall, plant a High-Voltage Pylon (4.5s, max 2/player). Two pylons stretch an Electric Cutter Wire (26 Shock DMG/s).

bullet_orbit_return.name: Orbit Return
bullet_orbit_return.desc: Ranged projectiles reaching max range curve 180° back toward your current position, dealing 45% Poison DMG from behind enemies.

duo_superheated_cyclone.name: Superheated Cyclone
duo_superheated_cyclone.desc: Vaporize spawns a homing Superheated Cyclone (4.0s, max 3) chasing enemies at 140 px/s, dealing 14 DMG/s and applying Steam Blindness.

duo_cryo_shatter_spires.name: Cryo Shatter Spires
duo_cryo_shatter_spires.desc: Shatter plants 4 Cryo Spires (4.0s) that block enemy bullets; Dash-Kicking through a spire detonates it for 34 Ice DMG (r=80px) and 1.2s Freeze.

duo_superconduct_rail.name: Superconduct Magnetic Rail
duo_superconduct_rail.desc: Superconducted enemies project a magnetic field (r=100px) that bends passing ranged projectiles directly toward their center.

duo_napalm_chain_plague.name: Napalm Chain Plague
duo_napalm_chain_plague.desc: Toxic Blast splashes Napalm-Venom Resin (5.0s) onto foes within 160px; slaying afflicted enemies triggers a 32 Fire DMG chain explosion (r=110px).

duo_plasma_overload_star.name: Plasma Overload Star
duo_plasma_overload_star.desc: Overload launches a piercing Plasma Star (420 px/s, 30 DMG) that bounces 3 times off walls across the room (0.35s ICD).

duo_magnetic_bastion_ring.name: Magnetic Bastion Ring
duo_magnetic_bastion_ring.desc: All pairs of Flipped Barricades [E] within 220px automatically link with High-Voltage Arc Wires dealing 28 Shock DMG/s to crossing enemies.
